Intro: Hey, Chef. I was wondering if you are willing to spare some more food.
I'm trying to scrape by through honest means, but no place is willing to hire a beggar like me. I have to resort to pleading like this to fill my stomach.
Rather be pathetic than dead. Anything will work, Chef, just something with nutrition.
Success: You really put the effort into this craft, huh? I'm impressed. Thank you.
Reject: Ah, well it was worth a try.
